Package org.cyborgcats.io.vision

Record Class VisionCameraIO.VisionCfg

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
org.cyborgcats.io.vision.VisionCameraIO.VisionCfg
Record Components:
name - unique camera name (must match the PhotonVision camera name)
width - image width in pixels
height - image height in pixels
cameraMatrix - 3×3 intrinsic camera matrix as a flat 9-element row-major array
distCoeffs - lens distortion coefficients (length 4 or 5)
robotToCamera - supplier returning the transform from robot origin to camera lens
Enclosing interface:
VisionCameraIO
public static record VisionCameraIO.VisionCfg(String name, int width, int height, double[] cameraMatrix, double[] distCoeffs, Supplier<Transform3d> robotToCamera) extends Record
Configuration record for a vision camera instance.
